raw_products.bookDescription:
Are you looking for a way to help children grieve after the loss of a family dog? There are no magic words that completely heal during deep loss. But, connecting with loved ones and sharing memories are important steps in the healing journey.
Our Favorite Dog Memories: Finding Comfort Through Coloring Together is here to help families navigate through this tough time with love, creativity, and shared moments of joy. This book is designed to help children ages 3-12 and their families celebrate and remember their furry friend. With 15 thoughtful prompts, this book encourages families to draw and share their favorite memories of their dog, fostering healing and connection.
Drawing Prompts Include:
My dog's favorite sleeping position
My dog's favorite sleeping position
My dog taking a car ride
My dog taking a car ride
My dog's favorite thing to do
My dog's favorite thing to do
My dog's favorite toy
My dog's favorite toy
Grab some crayons and gather around the table or find a comfy spot on the floor. You don’t need to be an artist to find comfort in this book. Each prompt is simple yet profound, inviting families to draw, re-tell stories, and remember the joy their dog brought into their lives. Use this book to create space to connect with those you love. The experience of creating these drawings can help families process their grief together, turning sorrow into cherished memories.
A Thoughtful Gift:Are you searching for the right way to help a friend? It’s hard to know how to help grieving friends. This book is a simple, but meaningful, gift to share with others. It’s an important way to show your love and support. It will be one of those gifts that makes a huge impact on your friend’s healing journey.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Simple  + Meaningful Way to Process the Loss of a Pet
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Losing a pet is an incredibly difficult experience, especially for families with young children. Recently, I discovered this unique and touching resource that can help other families navigate this challenging time: a coloring book designed to help mourn the loss of a beloved pet.One of the standout features is the inclusion of prompts that encourages sharing memories and expressing emotions. Each page has a simple prompt yet is profoundly therapeutic, helping children articulate their feelings and remember their four-legged family members during the grieving process in a meaningful way.Overall, this coloring book is a remarkable tool for families mourning the loss of a pet. It provides a creative and supportive space for children and adults alike to process their grief, share cherished memories, and find comfort in a difficult time. I highly recommend it to any family experiencing the loss of a pet – it’s more than just a coloring book; it’s a pathway to healing.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: My family loves this book. Our sweet dog has been gone for 2.5 months and my kids (4 &7) years are still pulling this coloring book out to remember her. They hadn’t touched it for several weeks and tonight my oldest asked me where it was and he and his brother sat and drew pictures and talked about our dog that we all loved so much. We received some great books when our dog died, but this is by far the most impactful to our family. We’ve loved sitting around together and remembering her. The intro is also really helpful, reminding kids (and adults) that all emotions are normal and healthy and offers space to cry as needed.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on February 27, 2025

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: No pictures to color - only places to draw
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a nice idea, but I expected there to be pictures to color.  Instead, it is blank sheets of paper with a drawing prompt involving a dog. There are also some additional tips for other things to do to remember your dog in the back of the book.  If you just want to draw, and need prompts, then this is the book for you.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 14, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A wonderful way to help families process the grief of losing a beloved pet
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Losing a family pet is heartbreaking, but this book helps families process that grief in a beautiful way. Making art and engaging in creative processes has been shown to have so many therapeutic benefits, and this book is a brilliant way to facilitate healing through shared creativity. The prompts are perfectly crafted to elicit fond memories and family bonding. It’s not overly complicated, making it completely accessible to all age groups. I am going to purchase a few copies to have on hand for when family and friends need comforting.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Helps little ones process the loss of their pet
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a useful, age appropriate way for young children to process the death of their dog. This book prompts them to think about and draw their dog doing different things, things that were normal, sweet and fun. Little ones can’t always verbalize their feeling, plus, this may be their first experience with death. This book provides a positive way to handle these feelings.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 6, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Helpful for kids and adults alike
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This book is so sweet and so thoughtful. I know it’s geared towards kids, but I feel like it’d be great for adults as well. It really makes you reminisce about the good, the silly, and the endearingly odd things about your dog. Prepare to cry your eyes out though! I would definitely recommend this to anyone experiencing pet loss.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 9, 2024

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I just received Our Favorite Dog Memories today.My only regret is that I didn’t have this book when I was a school counselor. I would have had several so that I could send one home with a student whose family had lost their beloved dog. Many times a lost of a pet is a child’s first experience with handling death. This book provides a path for turning the grief into treasured memories for both children and parents.

raw_products.bookDescription:
This is a heartfelt coloring book designed to help children navigate the emotional journey of losing their beloved cat. Coloring has been shown to have therapeutic benefits, such as reducing stress and promoting relaxation. Through a combination of creative coloring, thought-provoking prompts, and engaging activities, this beautifully crafted book creates a safe and comforting environment for children to process their emotions and honor the memory of their cherished pet in a meaningful and uplifting manner.
Features:
Beautiful Illustrations: Each page features comforting and whimsical illustrations of cats in various playful and peaceful settings, inviting children to bring them to life with color.
Beautiful Illustrations: Each page features comforting and whimsical illustrations of cats in various playful and peaceful settings, inviting children to bring them to life with color.
Memory Pages: Special sections encourage children to draw or color their favorite memories with their cat, helping them cherish and remember the happy times.

Affirmations and Quotes: Positive affirmations and gentle quotes about love, loss, and healing are scattered throughout the book, offering comfort and reassurance.

Guided Reflections: Simple, age-appropriate prompts guide children through reflecting on their emotions and understanding that it’s okay to feel sad, happy, or even confused.

This coloring book is a comforting and tender guide for children as they navigate through a challenging period of grief, providing them with a gentle outlet to express their emotions and cherish the memories of their beloved furry companion. Its pages are filled with heartwarming illustrations that serve as a reminder of the joy and love shared with their pet, bringing comfort and solace during this difficult time.
